segments.name: Restaurant
segments.description: Owns and operates quick-service, casual, and fine-dining restaurants across the Midwest, Massachusetts, and Florida, serving drive-thru, take-out, and dine-in customers.
segments.evidence: The Company has determined that it operates as a single reportable segment based on the nature of its operations and the regulatory environment in which it operates.

revenueModel.text: Customers pay the company for restaurant food and beverage sales, including drive-thru, take-out, curbside, and third-party delivery orders.
revenueModel.evidence: Burger Time serves the drive-thru and take-out segment of the restaurant industry.

changes.text: In 2025, the company closed its Village Bier Garten restaurant in Cocoa, Florida.
changes.evidence: Village Bier Garten, a German-themed restaurant, bar, and entertainment venue located in Cocoa, Florida, ceased operations and was permanently closed in January 2025.

changes.text: In 2025, the company entered a proposed business combination with Aero Velocity Inc. and plans to spin off its restaurant operations into BT Group, Inc.
changes.evidence: On September 2, 2025, we entered into an agreement to pursue a proposed business combination with Aero Velocity Inc., a private company that designs and manufactures American-made unmanned aerial vehicles and operates a Drones-as-a-Service business.

changes.text: In 2025, the company closed its Burger Time restaurant in Minot, North Dakota, following closures in Sioux Falls and Ham Lake in 2024.
changes.evidence: In July 2025, we ceased operating Burger Time in Minot, North Dakota.
